# AirReps

> AirReps is the largest community for AirPods replicas — also called fake AirPods or AirPods clones. The AirReps Ultimate Guide covers which replica AirPods to buy, how to buy them, trusted sellers, version comparisons, features, sound quality, troubleshooting, and more. Available in 9 languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Turkish, Russian, Polish, Danish) at airpodsreplicas.com.

AirReps helps people make informed purchasing decisions about AirPods replicas. The guide is community-maintained, constantly updated, and covers every model from AirPods 2 through AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max. The community also runs a Discord server and subreddit.

Last updated: 2026-09-16
